description: This script processes image files for different screen densities, applying borders and edge detection, and composing images with offsets. It is used for preparing layered images for an Android app or similar project.

methods.name: _run_cmd
methods.description: Executes a shell command and prints its output.

methods.name: _ask_script_border
methods.description: Creates a bordered version of an input image using an external script.

methods.name: _canny_edge_image
methods.description: Generates a canny edge image with transparency and fill adjustments.

methods.name: _edge_border
methods.description: Creates an edge border effect on an image using ImageMagick.

methods.name: _edge_image
methods.description: Wrapper for _ask_script_border to generate an outlined image.
